title: Identification of Exosome-Associated Biomarkers in Diabetic Foot Ulcers: A Bioinformatics Analysis and Experimental Validation.
authors: Li, Tianbo; Gao, Lei; Wang, Jiangning
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学分析鉴定糖尿病足溃疡外泌体相关生物标志物，虽含分子对接但核心为表达谱与临床诊断，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Background: Diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs) are a severe complication of diabetes and are characterized by impaired wound healing and a high amputation risk. Exosomes-which are nanovesicles carrying proteins, RNAs, and lipids-mediate intercellular communication in wound microenvironments, yet their biomarker potential in DFUs remains underexplored. Methods: We analyzed transcriptomic data from GSE134431 (13 DFU vs. 8 controls) as a training set and validated findings in GSE80178 (6 DFU vs. 3 controls). A sum of 7901 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) of DFUs were detected and intersected with 125 literature-curated exosome-related genes (ERGs) to yield 51 candidates. This was followed by GO/KEGG analyses and a PPI network construction. Support vector machine-recursive feature elimination (SVM-RFE) and the Boruta random forest algorithm distilled five biomarkers (DIS3L, EXOSC7, SDC1, STX11, SYT17). Expression trends were confirmed in both datasets. Analyses included nomogram construction, functional and correlation analyses, immune infiltration, GSEA, gene co-expression and regulatory network construction, drug prediction, molecular docking, and RT-qPCR validation in clinical samples. Results: A nomogram combining these markers achieved an acceptable calibration (Hosmer-Lemeshow p = 0.0718, MAE = 0.044). Immune cell infiltration (CIBERSORT) revealed associations between biomarker levels and NK cell and neutrophil subsets. Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) implicated IL-17 signaling, proteasome function, and microbial infection pathways. A GeneMANIA network highlighted RNA processing and vesicle trafficking. Transcription factor and miRNA predictions uncovered regulatory circuits, and DGIdb-driven drug repurposing followed by molecular docking identified Indatuximab ravtansine and heparin as high-affinity SDC1 binders. Finally, RT-qPCR validation in clinical DFU tissues (n = 5) recapitulated the bioinformatic expression patterns. Conclusions: We present five exosome-associated genes as novel DFU biomarkers with diagnostic potential and mechanistic links to immune modulation and vesicular transport. These findings lay the groundwork for exosome-based diagnostics and therapeutic targeting in DFU management.
abstract_zh: 背景：糖尿病足溃疡（DFU）是糖尿病的严重并发症，其特征为伤口愈合受损和高截肢风险。外泌体——携带蛋白质、RNA和脂质的纳米囊泡——在伤口微环境中介导细胞间通讯，然而其在DFU中的生物标志物潜力仍未充分探索。方法：我们分析了GSE134431（13例DFU对比8例对照）的转录组数据作为训练集，并在GSE80178（6例DFU对比3例对照）中验证发现。共检测到7901个DFU差异表达基因（DEGs），并与125个文献整理的外泌体相关基因（ERGs）取交集，得到51个候选基因。随后进行了GO/KEGG分析和PPI网络构建。支持向量机-递归特征消除（SVM-RFE）和Boruta随机森林算法筛选出五个生物标志物（DIS3L、EXOSC7、SDC1、STX11、SYT17）。在两个数据集中均确认了表达趋势。分析包括列线图构建、功能和相关性分析、免疫浸润、GSEA、基因共表达和调控网络构建、药物预测、分子对接以及临床样本中的RT-qPCR验证。结果：结合这些标志物的列线图达到了可接受的校准度（Hosmer-Lemeshow p = 0.0718，MAE = 0.044）。免疫细胞浸润（CIBERSORT）揭示了生物标志物水平与NK细胞和中性粒细胞亚群之间的关联。基因集富集分析（GSEA）涉及IL-17信号传导、蛋白酶体功能和微生物感染通路。GeneMANIA网络突出了RNA加工和囊泡运输。转录因子和miRNA预测揭示了调控回路，DGIdb驱动的药物再利用及随后的分子对接鉴定出Indatuximab ravtansine和肝素为高亲和力SDC1结合剂。最后，在临床DFU组织（n = 5）中的RT-qPCR验证重现了生物信息学表达模式。结论：我们提出五个外泌体相关基因作为新型DFU生物标志物，具有诊断潜力及与免疫调节和囊泡运输相关的机制联系。这些发现为DFU管理中基于外泌体的诊断和治疗靶向奠定了基础。
